candidateIdentityVerdict.revisionReason: The pair is a semantic grouping shared by many printing occurrences, not an occurrence key. UUID remains occurrence authority; semantic-face value must be explicit and nullable-safe.
candidateIdentityVerdict.semanticFaceRule: Use explicit side when present; otherwise 'none'. Treat the pair as semantic grouping, never occurrence uniqueness. Preserve missing Oracle IDs as null and do not invent identity from names or positions.

uuid.crossSnapshotStability: upstream contract; not longitudinally measured from one release
uuid.role: unique MTGJSON printing/face occurrence identifier within the pinned snapshot
